interactionSourceContracts.qualification: Event-contract regression on the actual interaction source in a minimal DOM harness; native rendering, pointer interception and production routing require the separate browser audit.

reflectionVisibility.qualification: Bounded naturally elapsed visible cap-reflection phases; ordinary unpaused paint requests, no clock seeking. A phase with actual nonzero opacity is saved for each cap.

motion.qualification: Read-only computed values and actual animation objects sampled during natural elapsed time. Reduced motion uses a native browser media preference; no clock seeking, synthetic lifecycle event, CSS or DOM modifications.

home.qualification: Actual native inputs, reloads and hit testing; no substituted data, manipulated DOM/CSS, sought animation phases or altered clock.
